result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom navigation all render correctly. The partially visible carousel item at the right edge ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected scroll affordances, not defects. One genuine cosmetic issue remains: a misspelling in the search placeholder.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
